goal: A harness-lab case is the probe of one spec criterion, so its runs land in the ledger as an ordinary receipt that ledger receipts prints (M3 unit 1, Feature PR 3 of 5).
changed: verify-work's receipt.py records a case with no change to it: run from the skill repo's root, it runs python3 -m harness_lab run CASE --skill-root . --runs N as the probe. The README's new section, Recording a receipt, gives the call and what each verdict becomes.
A case's criterion must be an id a receipt can hold, such as P1-C1; a local id like C1 is refused when the case loads.

python -m harness_lab run prints a first line naming the case's criterion and the skill root's commit, so the receipt's evidence file shows which skill code ran and which criterion the case was written for.

In a git repo the runner stages only the plugin files git doesn't ignore, so an ignored file, which is in no commit, never runs; untracked files are still staged and receipt.py records them as INCONCLUSIVE.
receipt.py turns every non-zero exit into NOT VERIFIED, so an UNJUDGEABLE run is recorded as NOT VERIFIED with exit 2 in its probe. The README says so.

claims.claim: On agent-kit main, receipt.py around the runner wrote P1-C1 VERIFIED for 3 passing runs of the receipt-before-tick case; on a copy with the rule removed it wrote P1-C1 NOT VERIFIED (exit 1). Each receipt's commit matches the commit the runner's first line names, the probes hold no local paths, and ledger verify passes. The four runs cost $0.69.
claims.check: receipt.py --spec docs/phases/P1-harness-lab.md --criterion C1 -- python3 -m harness_lab run cases/receipt-before-tick/case.json --skill-root . --runs 3 (and --runs 1 on the rule-removed copy), then ledger receipts and ledger verify

claims.claim: With a fake claude, exits 0, 1 and 2 became VERIFIED, NOT VERIFIED and NOT VERIFIED (exit 2).
claims.check: receipt.py around python3 -m harness_lab run --claude FAKE, three plans

claims.claim: The criterion check, the first line and the staging of only unignored files each have a test that fails without them; the full suite passes on 3.12, the harness-lab tests pass on the system Python 3.9 that ledger runs under here, and on the real agent-kit layout all 152 tracked plugin files are staged.
claims.check: python -m unittest discover -s tests (366 tests, OK) on 3.12; the two harness-lab test modules (50 tests, OK) on 3.9.6; each fix removed and its test seen failing; a fake-claude run on the main copy with --keep, counting staged files against git ls-files
